value.title: Directory polish: lineage import, batch assign, zones, window names, lock retry, the F003 flake

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "Ten tasks, one coder. F003 first (it flakes CI), then zones, window rule and the writer marker, then the two verbs (lineage add, assign --batch) on a shared assign path, then shared-build's owner, cost and docs, and last the cost rule that runs every shared-build cargo command niced and in background QoS."

value.title: F003: deterministic fresh_from and the same-second test
value.success: holders::fresh_from takes its clock as an argument (fresh_from_at), so a unit test proves a collision moves `from` on by a millisecond without the wall clock. The #122 HTTP test drops the same-second precondition and keeps proving that assign, release and reassign make two distinct holdings that survive a rebuild.
value.notes: If the prime's rule deletes the test on a CI failure first, this task restores it in its deterministic form.

value.title: F13: zoned dates written; local time with zone in the view
value.success: Changelog rows the writer stamps carry a UTC timestamp to the millisecond with Z (like holders rows), so the date is never ambiguous; holders rows already carry Z. The human `pij directory` view prints each live holder's since in local time with its offset; --json keeps the stored UTC value.
value.notes: UTC with Z in the documents costs no launch in the daemon; the CLI reads the local offset once per human view.

value.title: F17: a two-role seat's window keeps its first holding's name
value.success: On assign, the window is renamed only when the new holding is the seat's earliest open holding; otherwise the rename is skipped (no launch) and data.window says which holding names it. Documented in pij-rs-api.md.

value.title: F18: the writer's owner marker and its lock retry
value.success: While the writer stages and commits, it keeps <git dir>/pij-writer.owner (daemon pid, time, commit subject), found in-process from the worktree's .git file, removed on every exit path. Its existing bounded retry on a foreign index.lock ends in E-RS-GOV-LOCKED naming the lock. The community procedures tell a human who sees the marker or an index.lock to retry after a moment.
value.notes: The governance community README is the prime's; ask pm-001 to relay the one-line note there.

value.title: F15: pij directory lineage add
value.success: `pij directory lineage add <role>[/<instance>] <seat> --from <time> --to <time> --why <text>` (prime only) writes one closed row into the role's holders document in one writer commit and indexes it without touching seat roles; no live seat needed. Refuses a non-prime (E-RS-OWNERSHIP), from not before to, a time in the future, a bad time, and an overlap with any row of that seat and instance (E-RS-DIRECTORY-OVERLAP).
value.notes: Times: RFC 3339 with Z or an offset, or a bare date (UTC midnight); stored as UTC ms Z.

value.title: F16: pij directory assign --batch <file>
value.success: `pij directory assign --batch <file> --why <text>` reads `<role>[/<instance>] <seat>` lines (blank and # lines skipped) and records every holding in one writer commit, all or nothing: an unknown role, an absent or closed seat, a holding already open or a repeated line refuses the whole batch naming every bad line. Each holding then gets the single assign's store row, seat role, hook and window rule.
value.notes: Single assign becomes a batch of one, so both share one path.

value.title: F24: shared-build's owner names the seat
value.success: The owner line's seat is PIJ_ID, else PIJ_SESSION_ID (every harness seat has it), else the id `pij-rs whoami --json` returns (once per run, through a test seam), else $USER.
value.notes: TS test proof is CI-only (C25); checked locally by running the script with a fake whoami.

value.title: Cost receipts
value.success: Batch assign is one writer commit for N holders; lineage add one commit; the lock retry is the existing bounded one; a skipped rename launches nothing. spawn_sites.rs passes; private-daemon ping deltas per verb and live at-rest readings are in the evidence.

value.title: Docs and states
value.success: pij-rs-api.md documents lineage add, assign --batch, the zone rule, the window rule, the marker and the refusals; directory help and the skill's directory row carry them; difficulties.md marks F13, F15, F16 resolved and adds resolved rows for F17, F18, F24 and #122 F003; ddocs-check passes; PR body has a Delivers line.

value.title: Cost rule: shared-build runs cargo niced and in background QoS
value.success: Each cargo command runs as /usr/bin/nice -n 19 /usr/sbin/taskpolicy -b cargo ..., with taskpolicy skipped where absent (Linux CI); both paths are test seams.
value.notes: TS test proof is CI-only (C25); checked locally with a fake cargo under a fake and the real taskpolicy.

tk-0001.assertion: holders unit test: fresh_from_at with a row already at that millisecond returns the next millisecond; the HTTP test passes 50 runs in a row under parallel load.

tk-0002.assertion: A stamped changelog row and a holders row end in Z and round-trip; the local render of 2026-11-06T00:07:12.000Z at +600 is 2026-11-06 10:07:12 +10:00.

tk-0003.assertion: HTTP test: assigning a seat a second role leaves its window named for the first; the second receipt's window says renamed false with the reason.

tk-0004.assertion: Writer test: with a foreign index.lock held, the marker exists while the writer retries and is gone after; a lock held past the retries refuses E-RS-GOV-LOCKED and leaves no marker.

tk-0005.assertion: HTTP test: the prime records a closed seat's past holding (one commit, row in the view's lineage, no seat role); a non-prime is refused; an overlapping row is refused; to before from is refused.

tk-0006.assertion: HTTP test: eight holders in one commit; a file with one bad line commits none and names it.

tk-0007.assertion: shared-build.test.ts (CI) and a local run: with PIJ_ID and PIJ_SESSION_ID unset and a fake whoami, the owner line names the seat; with no whoami answer, the user.

tk-0008.assertion: spawn_sites green; private-daemon deltas for lineage add, assign --batch and a skipped rename recorded; live at-rest readings recorded.

tk-0009.assertion: ddocs-check passes; CI green on the exact head; reviewer, security and performance verdicts at that head.

tk-0010.assertion: shared-build.test.ts (CI) and a local run: every command of a --then batch reports niceness 19 and taskpolicy -b; with no taskpolicy, niceness 19 and no wrapper.
